question: Did --belief-grad-mode label_only (+ --win-prob-mode shaping 0.05) cost strength, and did belief calibration improve?
confound: TWO flags changed at once. The species regression below cannot be attributed to label_only alone; --win-prob-mode shaping adds a second trunk-shaping objective that competes for capacity. Not separable from these two runs.

elo.method: dense frozen-vs-frozen snapshot ladder, matched snapshot count n=12 (both runs 66/66 pairs, converged)

belief/species_acc.note: PERSISTENT regression, present from 4M on, not an endpoint artifact

verdict: Pre-registered §1 rule requires non-inferior AND calibration flat-or-up to flip the default. Non-inferiority passes; species calibration FAILS (-7 to -10 pts). Therefore label_only does NOT become the registry default.
interpretation: Cutting route C (PPO -> belief head params) LOWERED species accuracy. That inverts the motivating hypothesis: the policy gradient was HELPING that head, not corrupting it. Held with the confound caveat above.

step_budget.note: First run carrying the resume step-budget fix. 0.27% overshoot = one partial rollout (48 envs x 2048). Gen-9 and gen-10 both ran to ~26M (a full extra 1M) and needed manual killing.
